stem: Two rays $PA$ and $PC$ start at a point $P$ outside a circle and cut it, so that $\angle APC$ intercepts a far arc of ${=A}^\circ$ and a near arc of ${=B}^\circ$. Find $m\angle APC$ in degrees.
solution: For two rays intersecting outside a circle, the angle equals half the difference of the intercepted arcs (larger minus smaller).
notes: Placeholder parent_question_id; no book questions supplied. Standard: outside case, half-difference.
